title: ReCBM：用于概念瓶颈模型的不确定性门控关系推理
summary: ReCBM提出不确定性门控的关系推理框架，在概念瓶颈中引入语义关系（共现、蕴含、排斥），并用不确定性调节概念贡献，提升缺失/翻转概念下的鲁棒性，支持不确定性感知干预，提取紧凑概念子集而不损性能。
summary_en: ReCBM introduces an uncertainty-gated relational reasoning framework for Concept Bottleneck Models, modeling semantic relations among concepts and using uncertainty to modulate contributions, improving robustness under missing/flipped concepts and enabling uncertainty-aware intervention.
